messages:
marta: Quick triage — we've got 3 recurring field asks for Private (VPC / on-prem) from the last two weeks: in-place rolling upgrades, customer-managed networking (BGP/peering config handoff), and an offline upgrade bundle for air-gapped sites. Need to pick priorities and launch gates for the beta cohort.
aj: Agree. Which customers are pushing which items?
marta: TangoHealth and Luminare want in-place rolling upgrades. FinServCorp wants explicit customer-managed peering + config export/import. GovPartner asked for offline bundle + checksum-signed artifacts.
samuel: For rolling upgrades we need safe KV cache migration and a fallback path. Suggest: canary -> rolling with per-node draining -> automatic rollback if 5xx spike or latency > 2x baseline for 5m.
li: Implementation notes: rolling upgrade needs a lightweight agent migration protocol. We can expose an endpoint: `/admin/kv-checkpoint` that flushes the cache to persistent store. Also need config for max inflight during upgrade.
aj: From infra side, two quick asks: 1) define exact SLO triggers for rollback (latency, error rate), 2) define supported topology for peering (single-AZ vs multi-AZ).
marta: Proposed launch gates for beta: 1) telemetry + tracing for upgrade (span + per-model token latency), 2) scripted rollback validated in staging, 3) docs + ops runbook, 4) at least one pilot customer for each feature. Thoughts?
samuel: +1 on the gates. Add "migration tests" that replay live KV footprint on staging before rollout.
li: For customer-managed networking, ops team wants a canonical export file format. I suggest YAML with sections: `peers`, `routes`, `authentication` and an example: ```yaml peers:\n  - name: corp-router\n    asn: 65001\n    ip: 203.0.113.2\nroutes:\n  - prefix: 10.40.0.0/16\n    next_hop: 203.0.113.2\```
marta: Nice. We should also require a verification step (customer-originated signed challenge) before we commit BGP sessions. Security needed.
aj: For offline upgrade bundles: deliverables = signed tarball, sha256, minimal upgrader binary. We'll need an offline verification CLI like `rdu-upgrade verify ./bundle.tar.gz`.
samuel: Can we target the beta for Q3? Rollout plan: 2 week internal dogfood, 4 week pilot with 3 customers, then wider GA. That gives time to build runbooks.
marta: Timeline sounds good. Prioritization: 1) Rolling upgrades (highest customer demand + reduces churn), 2) customer-managed networking, 3) offline bundles. Does eng agree? @aj @li
aj: Agree, but call out risk: rolling upgrades require more test infra (chaos + perf). Need dedicated 2 sprints.
li: We'll need one extra SRE rotation for rollout support. Also need to lock KMS story for offline bundles (HSM/KMS integration, key-wrapping).
marta: Launch acceptance checklist draft (short):
  - upgrade telemetry integrated into Console routes
  - rollback policy automated and documented
  - export/import YAML spec + verification flow
  - signed offline bundle tooling + KMS integration
  - at least 1 pilot customer per feature
devops-bot: Deploy pipeline status: `private-upgrades/beta` -> passing (build 472). No infra changes detected.
samuel: Next steps: product drafts PRD for the beta (scope + gating + pilot criteria). Eng to create tickets: rolling-upgrade, network-export, offline-bundle. I'll coordinate pilot signups.
marta: Thanks. Can we sync Thurs 10am to lock scope? I'll send calendar invite. If anyone can't make it, drop blocker in this thread. :calendar: 
aj: I'll be there.
li: +1.
samuel: 👍
marta: OK, capturing action items. Closing thread after invite posted.
